title: The finite Gaussian BRST factor inherits the full scalar-recentering instability window

brst_window_transfer.full_family: For every scalar a_N use mathbb K_N(a)=(H_N-a_N) tensor 1+1 tensor Delta_BRST on K1471's finite-cutoff tensor form domain
brst_window_transfer.harmonic_vacuum: The fixed BRST Laplacian has a normalized degree-zero harmonic vacuum eta with Delta_BRST eta=0
brst_window_transfer.spectral_transfer: Tensoring K1484's Ritz vector with eta gives exactly the matter recentered form value, so every K1485 excluded scalar window also has full BRST spectral bottom tending to minus infinity
brst_window_transfer.weak_transfer: u_N tensor eta converges weakly to (1/sqrt(2))1 tensor eta, a nonzero harmonic vector
brst_window_transfer.mosco_transfer: The full BRST forms and their degree-zero harmonic compression fail weak Mosco liminf throughout the same excluded scalar window
brst_window_transfer.cohomology_boundary: Closed nilpotence and finite-cutoff positive cohomology remain algebraically valid but neither selects the matter counterterm nor repairs its continuum energy origin
brst_window_transfer.ceiling: The transfer is conditional on the fixed Gaussian BRST tensor construction. It supplies no source-owned interacting BRST charge, common continuum domain, ground-energy lower bound or physical GU cohomology
